label: PF Backlog 287
title: Provider health tracking (availability/rate-limits/errors/latency) feeding routing + dashboard (Doc2 s6/s17)
body: Doc2 s6/s17. Only a retired flag exists; routing cannot consider provider health, rate limits, errors or latency. Need a provider-health store (single writer) updated from call outcomes, surfaced to the router and dashboard. Owns core/provider_health.py + store.
